svg.title: Player / audience lifecycle
svg.desc: Baseline: viewers interact through the live platform, without a Chorus connection. Target lifecycle; implementation and acceptance are tracked separately.
svg.text: Player / audience lifecycle
Baseline: viewers interact through the live platform, without a Chorus connection.
01 Enter a live stream
Watch the streamer and the current gameplay.
02 Check whether a round is open
The live gameplay binding identifies the target round.
03 Send a comment, like or gift
The platform supplies event identity and live context.
04 Verify and route the event
PlatformGateway pushes to the routed RoomActor.
05 Durably accept the event
GameServer persists through DataServer before ACK.
06 Apply the event in a committed tick
Deduplicate, order and apply; then publish the effect.
07 See the result and reward status
A frozen result and completed rewards are distinct.
08 Continue watching or leave
A later round is a new participation context.
No active round / input closed
Use the explicit out-of-round policy.
Do not guess a room or imply a game effect.
Retries / late arrivals
Keep the first accepted round attribution.
Deduplicate; terminal handling after closure.
Target design · Durable acceptance ≠ applied effect · Close ACK precedes platform-end call
